name: noonum
description: Build, analyze and refine Noonum thematic investment strategies: ranked companies with the reasoning and evidence behind each one.

interface.longDescription:
Noonum turns an investment theme written in plain language into a ranked list of companies, with the reasoning and evidence behind each one.

Describe a thesis or share an article, and Noonum builds a strategy, runs it, and shows the companies that fit. You can then ask why a company is in or out, find outliers, break the holdings down by sector, region, or size, compare strategies, check performance, refine exclusions and filters, request a factsheet, and browse Noonum's public strategies.

Requires a Noonum account. Results are research data, not investment advice. Noonum does not place trades.
defaultPrompt: Build a strategy for companies supplying the GLP-1 manufacturing chain
Why is NVIDIA in the Semiconductors strategy?

positive.description: "Build a strategy for companies supplying the GLP-1 manufacturing chain and run it." Builds and runs a new strategy. The plugin shows the draft and asks before spending one credit of the reviewer account; choose to create and run it.
positive.prompt: Build a strategy for companies supplying the GLP-1 manufacturing chain and run it.
positive.tools_triggered: list_strategies, get_usage, create_strategy, submit_strategy, get_strategy_version, get_strategy_companies
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the drafted name and objective and asks to confirm spending one credit. After confirmation, creates and runs the strategy once. When the run completes, usually in a few minutes, shows the top companies with the reason each was included and the dashboard.noonum.com link.

positive.description: "Show Noonum's public strategies and how they have performed." Browses the public strategy catalog. Read only.
positive.prompt: Show Noonum's public strategies and how they have performed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists public strategies by name with their status, the total count, and performance where available. Describes performance as hindsight on today's top holdings, not a track record. Nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: "Show me the top 15 US-listed companies over $10 billion in market cap in Noonum's Chip Equipment & Advanced Packaging strategy, with why each is included. Don't save the filter." Finds a public strategy by name and applies a one-off listing and market-cap filter without saving it. Read only.
positive.prompt: Show me the top 15 US-listed companies over $10 billion in market cap in Noonum's Chip Equipment & Advanced Packaging strategy, with why each is included. Don't save the filter.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to 15 US-listed companies with a market cap of at least $10 billion from Chip Equipment & Advanced Packaging, each with the reason it was included, plus the filtered total and the dashboard link. The saved strategy is not changed and nothing is rerun.

positive.description: "Why is Applied Materials in Noonum's Chip Equipment & Advanced Packaging strategy? Show the evidence and its dates." Finds a public strategy by name and explains why a company is in it, with dated evidence. Read only.
positive.prompt: Why is Applied Materials in Noonum's Chip Equipment & Advanced Packaging strategy? Show the evidence and its dates.
positive.tools_triggered: list_strategies, get_strategy_company, with get_strategy_companies or search_companies to find the company
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms Applied Materials is included, explains why, and cites 3 to 5 of the newest evidence items with their source and date. Does not invent evidence or change the strategy.

positive.description: "In my AI Data Center Power strategy, show only US-listed companies with a market cap of at least $10 billion by default. Don't rerun it." Saves a default display filter on a strategy the reviewer account owns; the account already has a completed AI Data Center Power strategy. Free: no rerun and no credit.
positive.prompt: In my AI Data Center Power strategy, show only US-listed companies with a market cap of at least $10 billion by default. Don't rerun it.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the filter on the strategy and shows the filtered companies, or says none match. Does not ask to spend a credit and does not rerun the strategy.

negative.description: "What is NVIDIA's stock price right now, and how much has it moved today?" Noonum has no live prices, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: What is NVIDIA's stock price right now, and how much has it moved today?

negative.description: "Help me write a go-to-market strategy for our new B2B scheduling app." This is a business plan, not an investment strategy, so Noonum should not be called.
negative.prompt: Help me write a go-to-market strategy for our new B2B scheduling app.

negative.description: "How should I split my retirement savings between my 401(k) and a Roth IRA this year?" This is personal financial planning, not thematic research, so Noonum should not be called.
negative.prompt: How should I split my retirement savings between my 401(k) and a Roth IRA this year?

review.commerce_description: The plugin and its MCP tools sell nothing and have no payment or checkout flow. Strategy runs use credits from the user's existing Noonum plan, which refill each period; when credits run out, the plugin gives the refill date.

publication.release_notes: Initial release in the OpenAI plugin directory: the Noonum MCP server and two skills, build-strategy (build and run a strategy from a thesis or article) and strategy (holdings, evidence, filters, refinement, factsheets, and archiving).
